The '''1990–91 [[La Liga]]''' season was the 60th since its establishment. It began on 1 September 1990, and concluded on 9 June 1991. [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] ended [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]]'s five-year run as champions to seal the title.
